mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(legacy.used_count, 0) + GREATEST(dated.used_count - COALESCE(legacy.detail_count_at_cutover, 0), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(1) AS used_count FROM sign_supplement_used WHERE user_id = #{userId}) dated LEFT JOIN sign_supplement_legacy_used legacy ON legacy.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_supplement_used (user_id, sign_date, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{signDate}, #{createTime})
